deploy-bot: [deploy] hotfix rollout initiated for prod-us-east-1
commit: 9f1a2b3
tag: v1.13.2-hotfix-20260319
canary: 10% for 12m -> will auto-promote on green checks
change-window: 03:00-04:00 UTC
config-pins: model=redwood-moderate-7b@v2.1.0-quant, enable_kv_prefetch=false

maria-garcia: @deploy-bot noted. I'll watch error budget / 95p latency. ping me if any surge :eyes:

ian_devops: quick Q — why disable kv prefetch? last time that changed perf in canary, want to confirm rollback path if mem churn appears

deploy-bot: config reason: observed KV prefetch causing occasional OOM at scale in 7b quantized variant. rollback command is prepared: `redwood deploy rollback --tag v1.13.1-stable --env prod-us-east-1`

ron-qa: running smoke suite against canary. tests: auth, trace headers, prompt stewarding all passing so far (0/18 flakey).

maria-garcia: metrics starting to look ok. latency +0.8% p50, error-rate 0.12% (within threshold). :thumbsup:

jules-sre: getting a small spike in cache misses on one host, correlating with GPU mem pressure. putting that host in rotation to isolate (manual drain).

ian_devops: suggest holding promotion until we confirm drain stabilizes. reduce canary to 5% while we observe?

deploy-bot: adjusting canary -> 5% now. will hold auto-promote.

maria-garcia: ACK. watching for error-rate drift for next 10m.

(9 minutes later)

ron-qa: smoke still good, but one downstream rerank job timed out (300s). investigating whether it's model-side or infra retry. logs: `timeout waiting for kv-lookup` on host ip 10.12.5.7

jules-sre: that host still shows high GPU memory churn after drain. I'm recommending rollback to v1.13.1 to avoid user impact while we investigate further.

ian_devops: +1 for rollback. we shouldn't risk broader blast during change window.

maria-garcia: agree. error budget trend will worsen if this propagates. rolling back now.

deploy-bot: executing rollback -> `redwood deploy rollback --tag v1.13.1-stable --env prod-us-east-1 --force`

deploy-bot: rollback started (estimated 3m). will post updates when complete and when post-rollback smoke passes.

(2m later)

deploy-bot: rollback complete. current prod tag: v1.13.1-stable.

ron-qa: post-rollback smoke: all checks pass. no rerank timeouts observed.

jules-sre: removed problematic host from pool for deeper investigation, will repro in staging. created ticket INF-4272 with heap traces and kernel logs.

ian_devops: leaving kv_prefetch disabled on the next canary until we have a repro. We'll re-run with more controlled hosts.

maria-garcia: filing release note blurb & incident note. will schedule a follow-up retro tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: tag v1.13.2-hotfix-20260319 has been rolled back; live tag: v1.13.1-stable. thread closed unless anyone needs more follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
